answer: Each identity must win one service slot on the nebula auction board before the ember deadline, and lock a 60-credit bond on that slot. Slots sell in order, each next slot costing a delta of 5 credits more than the last, starting at 30, so the k-th slot costs 30 + 5(k-1) credits, the 1000th costs 5,025, and 1,000 fakes pay 2,527,500 for slots plus 60,000 in bonds. A slot cannot transfer to another key, and bids funded from one source are grouped and voided, so a bid-rental ring fails and its bonds burn. An honest seller buys one early slot and keeps its bond after service.
